lines.zh: 我踩着地面走，一步一步。
lines.en: I walk on the ground, one step at a time.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩一甩，晃得挺欢。
lines.en: My tail swishes along as I go.
There's a smell up ahead; let me check.
Bare feet on grass — no stones here.

lines.zh: 我蹦一下，能顶你们好几步。
lines.en: One hop of mine covers several of your steps.
My stomach's growling; let me walk faster.

lines.zh: 山那边好像有什么，我绕过去。
lines.en: Something's beyond that hill; I'll go around.

lines.zh: 身上的蓝衣服，是爷爷留下的。
lines.en: These blue clothes were my grandpa's.
I walk and watch the clouds as I go.

lines.zh: 脚下很轻，路上没留下印。
lines.en: My feet are light; no prints stay behind.

lines.zh: 有人在打架？我得去看看。
lines.en: A fight? I have to go look.

lines.zh: 走远一点，肚子就不叫了。
lines.en: Walk far enough and my belly stops complaining.

lines.zh: 我盘腿坐着，手放在膝盖上。
lines.en: I sit cross-legged, hands on my knees.
Have you eaten? I haven't.
Empty belly, empty head.
I lift my head and sniff — water nearby.

lines.zh: 不打的时候，我挺无聊的。
lines.en: When there's no fight, I get bored.

lines.zh: 爷爷说过，要变强就要练。
lines.en: Grandpa said strength comes from training.
My tail draws circles in the dirt on its own.
Sitting like this, my ki settles lower.

lines.zh: 这么久没人来，我快睡着了。
lines.en: No one's come in ages; I'm nearly asleep.
I clench my fists and let them go.

lines.zh: 这一片没有吃的，真可惜。
lines.en: Nothing to eat around here — a shame.

lines.zh: 等有人来，我就知道要做什么了。
lines.en: When someone comes, I'll know what to do.
My belly drums louder than thunder.
I breathe out and the grass bends.

lines.zh: 你身上有股强者的味道。
lines.en: You smell like someone strong.
Are you good, or bad?

lines.zh: 要不要比一场？我好久没打了。
lines.en: Want a match? I haven't fought in ages.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，先看清楚。
lines.en: I watch your hands and get a good look.
Did you bring any food?

lines.zh: 我歪着头看你，看不太懂。
lines.en: I tilt my head — I don't quite get you.
Your ki isn't that high; don't do anything rash.
I'm Son Goku. What about you?

lines.zh: 这样瞪着我看，是有什么事吗？
lines.en: Staring at me like that — something you need?
I raise my hands; no ill intent.
Not too close; I eat fiercely.
Are you here to train too?
One round and we'll know.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢输，但也不怕输。
lines.en: I don't like losing, but I'm not afraid of it.
What are you hesitating about?

lines.zh: 别看我的尾巴，会不好意思。
lines.en: Don't stare at my tail; it's embarrassing.
Fine — I'll wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 肚子有点饿，打起来会慢。
lines.en: I'm a bit hungry, so I'll be slow.
Ouch — that one landed.
I step back half a pace and shake my hand.
Interesting — do it again.
It hurts, but I can take it.
Your fist is harder than it looks.
I grit my teeth and grin.
I wipe my face and grin.

lines.zh: 气乱了一瞬，马上回来了。
lines.en: My ki scattered for a blink, then came back.
Another tear in my clothes.
Good — now I know how heavy your hands are.

lines.zh: 是吃的！我的鼻子不会错。
lines.en: Food! My nose is never wrong.
I'll eat all of it — all right?
I won't leave a bite — sorry.
At this smell, I could eat ten.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，手已经伸出去了。
lines.en: One step forward and my hand's already out.

lines.zh: 你真好，我以前只能抓鱼。
lines.en: You're kind; I used to make do with fish.
My belly says eat first, talk later.

lines.zh: 这么多？那我得坐下慢慢吃。
lines.en: This much? I'd better sit and take my time.

lines.zh: 吃饱了，我力气会大很多。
lines.en: Once I'm full, I'll be much stronger.
Don't take it; I've only had two bites.
I run straight into it and feel nothing.
Oops, sorry — I was daydreaming.
You're the one who bounced, right?

lines.zh: 我停住了，脚下踩出两个坑。
lines.en: I stop short, leaving two pits under me.

lines.zh: 怎么有东西挡在路中间？
lines.en: What's in the middle of the road?
I'll step aside; you first.
You bumped me — are you all right?
My head is hard; don't test it.
That knocked the dirt flying.

lines.zh: 走路不看路的毛病，改不了。
lines.en: I never look where I'm going — can't help it.
Fighting together? I like that.
You left, me right — don't wander.
With a partner, the fight's more fun.
If we win, we eat together — deal?
I'll go all out; keep up.

lines.zh: 你打得不错，我看得出来。
lines.en: You fight well; I can tell.

lines.zh: 别站我正后方，我挥拳大。
lines.en: Don't stand right behind me; my swings are wide.
We carry this fight together.

lines.zh: 我信你，把后面交给你了。
lines.en: I trust you — the back is yours.

lines.zh: 下次还找你一起，说定了。
lines.en: Next time I'll come find you. It's settled.
I pick it up and turn it over.
Can this be eaten? Doesn't look like it.
A sniff first, then a bite.
Hard as rock. I can't bite it, so I toss it.
Small enough for one hand.
I tuck it into my clothes.

lines.zh: 捡了这个，我能换顿饭吗？
lines.en: Does this buy me a meal?

lines.zh: 我举高看看，太阳照得亮。
lines.en: I hold it up; the sun makes it shine.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿有什么用，我不知道。
lines.en: What it's for, I honestly don't know.
Anything on the ground, I want to pick up.

lines.zh: 你的气变了，我打起精神。
lines.en: Your ki changed; I'm paying attention.
A fight? Then I'll start.
I crouch low and plant my feet.
This time I won't hold back.
Fists clenched, ki gathering in my palms.
You're my opponent — no swapping.
Eyes wide, I can see it all.
Once I catch you, we fight.

lines.zh: 你身上有股我讨厌的味道。
lines.en: You have a smell I don't like.

lines.zh: 爷爷教的，先站稳再出拳。
lines.en: Grandpa taught me: settle your feet first.

lines.zh: 我脚下一点，就到你面前。
lines.en: One push off the ground and I'm in front of you.
The ki in my palms is getting hot.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，看你什么时候动。
lines.en: I watch your feet for when you'll move.

lines.zh: 打之前说一句：我可不客气。
lines.en: One word before we start: I won't be gentle.

lines.zh: 这么强的对手，我有点兴奋。
lines.en: Such a strong opponent — I'm excited.
I'm ready whenever you are.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼近，脚下很稳。
lines.en: I close in step by step, feet steady.

lines.zh: 你往哪边跑，我就追哪边。
lines.en: Wherever you run, I follow.
I'm waiting for the charge to build. Almost.

lines.zh: 你出手太慢了，我看到了。
lines.en: You're too slow; I saw that coming.

lines.zh: 拳头一直举着，手都酸了。
lines.en: My fists are up so long they ache.
One more block and I can hit.
Stop dodging; you can't escape.

lines.zh: 气顺着脚往上走，走到拳头上。
lines.en: Ki runs up from my feet into my fists.

lines.zh: 我看着你的眼睛，那里会露馅。
lines.en: I watch your eyes; they give you away.
You hit true, but not fast enough.
I practiced this one a long time.
I circle you, hunting a straight line.

lines.zh: 手心对了，就是这个感觉。
lines.en: Palms right — this is the feeling.
Wait a moment; I want a clear shot.

lines.zh: 你退了那么多，后面是墙。
lines.en: You've backed so far — there's a wall behind you.
Just like that — holding still is best.
I count to three and then I move.
Ki's full; I can't hold it.
I throw a punch and the air cracks.

lines.zh: 我骑在筋斗云上，比你先到。
lines.en: On the cloud, I arrive before you.
The kick lands and I drive forward.
That one had seven tenths of my strength.

lines.zh: 手背扫过去，你退了半步。
lines.en: My backhand sweeps and you stagger half a step.

lines.zh: 打中了！我高兴得叫出声。
lines.en: Hit! I shout with delight.

lines.zh: 我的头撞上去，比拳还硬。
lines.en: My head-butts land harder than my fists.

lines.zh: 两拳连打，中间没有间隙。
lines.en: Two punches, no gap between them.

lines.zh: 你挡得不错，可还差一点。
lines.en: Good block, but not quite enough.
I step back and reset my fists.

lines.zh: 这一下是替被打的人还的。
lines.en: That was for whoever you hit.

lines.zh: 拳头碰到你，气就砰地炸开。
lines.en: My fist meets you and the ki bursts.

lines.zh: 我收拳很快，你来不及还手。
lines.en: I pull my fist back fast; you can't answer.

lines.zh: 力气太大，我自己都差点摔倒。
lines.en: So much force I nearly fell over myself.
That one — I can't laugh about it.

lines.zh: 打完我又退开，看你还能不能站。
lines.en: I back off again to see if you can still stand.

lines.zh: 我从天上掉下来，脚先落地。
lines.en: I drop from the sky, feet first.
My landing punches a small crater.

lines.zh: 这地方我没见过，是新地方。
lines.en: I've never seen this place — it's new.
First thing I do is look for food.
My tail moves before I do.
Anyone here? I'm Son Goku.

lines.zh: 身上这身衣服，是爷爷给的。
lines.en: These clothes came from my grandpa.
I stand straight and hold my ki in.

lines.zh: 这么一落地，周围都安静了。
lines.en: The moment I land, everything goes quiet.

lines.zh: 肚子又饿了，真拿它没办法。
lines.en: Hungry again — can't help it.
I look at my hands; the strength's still there.
Everyone here seems strong.
Come on, tell me what's going on.

lines.zh: 我把领口拉正，准备出发。
lines.en: I straighten my collar and get ready to go.

lines.zh: 刚才还在练功，一眨眼就到这。
lines.en: I was training, and now I'm here.

lines.zh: 这个世界的空气，挺新鲜的。
lines.en: The air in this world is fresh.

lines.zh: 没人在等我，那我就自己走。
lines.en: No one's waiting, so I'll go myself.

lines.zh: 我先喊一声，看看有没有回音。
lines.en: I'll shout once and see if anything answers.
Hot! I hop about slapping the flames.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，我屁股都麻了。
lines.en: I fall from high up and my backside goes numb.

lines.zh: 我不会游泳！水灌进来了！
lines.en: I can't swim! Water's pouring in!

lines.zh: 砰的一声，我被掀翻在地。
lines.en: A bang flips me onto the ground.

lines.zh: 扎进来的东西，我随手拔了。
lines.en: I pull out whatever stuck in me.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光缠着我，力气被抽走。
lines.en: Strange light wraps me and my strength drains.

lines.zh: 饿得站不稳，拳也没力气。
lines.en: Too hungry to stand steady; my punches are weak.
Lightning strikes and my whole body jerks.
The ground's gone and I'm falling.
